name: agentreplay
description: Record every step of an AI run, replay it, fork any step, and save failures as tests.
author: Deepak R

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w sdk && npm test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w sdk && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w sdk && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
